# BTicino C300X Native Agent Integration v0.7.0

Feature release for local call handling, doorbell media state, and explicit
camera stop controls.

## Added

- Native local Home Call support with Home Assistant services for start and
  stop.
- A dashboard-friendly doorbell video stop button and matching
  `bticino_c300x.stop_doorbell_video` service.
- A separate native doorbell ring media mode for real ring-call sessions.
- A bundled Lovelace card for doorstation video/talkback and the separate Home
  Call control, loaded automatically by the integration.

## Changed

- Updates the packaged native C300X device agent to `0.7.0`.
- Keeps audio requested while allowing video to start immediately if the
  audio track is slow or temporarily unavailable.

## Fixed

- Stops a Home Call cleanly when it is ended before the C300X answers.
- Clears stale doorbell media state on media-close events and TTL fallback.
- Reports HA-usable doorbell video availability separately from unrelated
  external media sessions.

## Notes

- This release keeps the Home Assistant minimum version at `2025.5.0`.
